info.title: STREAMERO API
info.description: Music & video streaming platform API. All endpoints are versioned under /v1. Errors use `{ error: { code, message, details? }, requestId }`.

idToken.description: ID token (JWT) issued by Google for one of the configured client IDs

nonce.description: Nonce sent in the Google authorization request; must equal the token nonce claim

at.description: When the change happened on the device (ISO 8601)

editorial.description: Editors only: create an editorial playlist

position.description: Insert position; defaults to the end

state.description: Opaque client state: queue, index, position, shuffle, repeat

baseVersion.description: Version the client last received (0 when none)

authorizationNote.description: Who owns the rights / why STREAMERO may store this file. Recorded in provenance.

path.description: Absolute path inside IMPORT_ALLOWED_DIRS (file or folder)

password.description: Omit to email the user a link to choose their own password

sendInvite.description: Also email a set-password link when a password is given

coverUrl.description: Cover Art Archive front cover (250 px)

releaseId.description: MusicBrainz release id (default: best release of the recording)

overwrite.description: Replace existing values (default: only fill empty/placeholder fields and missing artwork)
